caption: The chaincode caps the ₹1,20,000 bill at the ₹5,00,000 sum insured, takes off the ₹10,000 deductible and pays ₹1,10,000, leaving ₹3,90,000. When the same bill with hash H comes back, H is already in the paid-claims log, so the second payout is ₹0.

spec.title: Worked example: one claim, then the same bill again
spec.aria: A downward flow: an active policy with sum insured ₹5,00,000, a claim of ₹1,20,000 carrying hash H, the chaincode checks passing because H is unpaid, a payout of ₹1,10,000 after the ₹10,000 deductible, hash H stored with ₹3,90,000 of sum insured left, and the resubmitted claim rejected at ₹0.
